children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Control desired running state, graceful shutdown, and probe timing so slow games recover without restart loops or data loss.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Use intentional Stop or Suspend for maintenance; do not weaken probes to hide a real process failure.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Desired state determines whether Kubernetes maintains a running replica or scales the StatefulSet to zero.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Auto-restart on maintains Running after failures.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Turning it off reports Suspended and preserves persistent data.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Use Stop or Suspend intentionally for maintenance.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: The operator waits for the template stop sequence within the configured 0–600 second grace window.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Default grace is 30 seconds; large worlds may need more.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: The value matters only when the template declares a stop sequence.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Verify the final save through console and logs.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Override timing one probe family at a time; startup protects boot, readiness gates traffic, and liveness triggers recovery.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Auto-restart off → zero replicas, Suspended, data preserved

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Grace 0–600s; requires a template stop sequence

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Startup protects boot; readiness gates traffic; liveness recovers
